name: Varok Saurfang
summary: High Overlord Saurfang is a legendary orc warrior and a veteran of the Old Horde's wars. Serving as Warchief Thrall's trusted military commander in Orgrimmar, he represents the proud martial spine of the modern Horde.

sections.title: A Living Legend of the Wars
sections.body: Few living warriors possess a martial pedigree to rival Saurfang. A veteran of the Old Horde's wars, he is considered an unstoppable force on the battlefield. Today he stands in Orgrimmar as High Overlord, a bulwark of Thrall's newborn Horde.

sections.title: The Weight of the Blood
sections.body: Though he stands as an unmatched champion of the Horde, Saurfang is not driven by reckless battle-lust. While he will relentlessly defend the Horde and enforce Thrall's rule against any threat, Saurfang harbors a profound disdain for warmongering and fights strictly for honor and preservation.

faq.answer: High Overlord Saurfang is a renowned orc warrior and the primary military commander serving Warchief Thrall in the Horde.

faq.q: What wars did Saurfang fight in?
aliases: did saurfang fight in the first war
faq.answer: Saurfang is a veteran of the Old Horde's wars against the Alliance. Today he fights for Thrall's Horde.

faq.q: How does Saurfang view the Horde's past?
aliases: why does saurfang regret the past
faq.answer: Saurfang fought for the Old Horde in the days of the demon blood curse. Today he serves Thrall's Horde, which has turned away from that dark path.

faq.q: What is Saurfang's role in the current Horde?
faq.answer: He serves as High Overlord of Thrall's forces, overseeing military readiness, enforcing the Warchief's commands, and acting as a seasoned mentor to younger warriors within the Horde.

angles.text: To the orcs, High Overlord Saurfang is both the ultimate paragon of martial strength and a sobering reminder of the spiritual toll exacted by the demonic blood curse.
Warriors revere Saurfang as a peerless veteran whose axe technique, tactical battlefield brilliance, and enduring resolve define the ideal soldier.
